title: Improved verification limit for the convergence of the Collatz conjecture
status: located 2026-09-20 in the reference lists of both Hikawa preprints; unread; the DOI is copied from those lists and resolves to link.springer.com
notes: The Journal of Supercomputing 81 (2025), Article 810. Both Hikawa preprints cite it for the statement that computational verification of the Collatz conjecture has been extended to 2^71, in agreement with Roosendaal's computations. WHAT IT IS FOR THIS LABORATORY: the current published verification floor on the POSITIVE side (3x+1). The negative-floor dossier docs/problems/juggler_negative_floor_3x1.md and Paper A's Remark 5.20 concern the 3x-1 side, where the floor is this laboratory's 2^44 and the only published check is the unattributed 10^8 on A037084; where those texts quote Oliveira e Silva's 2.70e16 through Sinisalo for the positive side, this paper is the value that supersedes it, and Paper A's next revision should say so. Not read; nothing about its method is recorded here.
